title: Epic: Demo-ready — docker pull, open browser, play
description:
End-to-end demo path: docker run -p 8080:8080 ghcr.io/markatwood/baize, open browser, pick a game, play. Single container serves both the Rust WebSocket server and a static web client. No Flutter required — works in any browser including mobile.

Milestone for conference demos: 'available now, docker pull from github, open your phone browser.'
